mapper.sql: COALESCE(r.status, CASE d.da_status WHEN '1' THEN 'APPROVED' WHEN '2' THEN 'REJECTED' WHEN '3' THEN 'REVIEWING' WHEN '4' THEN 'INACTIVE' ELSE 'PENDING' END)

d.idx AS id, d.da_rider AS reporter, d.da_lat AS latitude, d.da_lon AS longitude, d.da_radius_m AS radius_m, d.da_addr AS address, d.da_content AS description, COALESCE(NULLIF(r.title, ''), LEFT(COALESCE(d.da_content, '위험지역 제보'), 50)) AS title, COALESCE(r.hazard_type, 'OTHER') AS hazard_type, AS status, COALESCE(r.created_at, d.create_date, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS created_at, COALESCE(r.updated_at, d.create_date, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dangerous_area d LEFT JOIN trailgo_hazard_review r ON r.hazard_id = d.idx WHERE d.da_lat BETWEEN #{minLat} AND #{maxLat} AND d.da_lon BETWEEN #{minLon} AND #{maxLon} AND COALESCE(r.is_active, 1) = 1 AND r.merged_into IS NULL AND (r.expires_at IS NULL OR r.expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND IN ('PENDING', 'REVIEWING', 'APPROVED') ORDER BY POW(d.da_lat - #{lat}, 2) + POW(d.da_lon - #{lon}, 2) ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM dangerous_area d LEFT JOIN trailgo_hazard_review r ON r.hazard_id = d.idx WHERE d.idx = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dangerous_area (da_rider, da_latitude, da_longitude, da_addr, da_image, da_content, da_status, da_radius_m) VALUES (#{row.reporter}, #{lat}, #{lon}, '', '', #{row.description}, '0', #{row.radiusM})

INSERT INTO trailgo_hazard_review (hazard_id, title, hazard_type, status, created_at, updated_at, confirm_count, report_count, is_active) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{type}, 'PENDING', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 0, 0, 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE dangerous_area SET da_content = #{description}, da_radius_m = #{radiusM} WHERE idx = #{id}
UPDATE trailgo_hazard_review SET title = #{title}, hazard_type = #{type}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE hazard_id = #{id}
UPDATE trailgo_hazard_review SET status = 'INACTIVE', is_active = 0, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE hazard_id = #{id}
UPDATE dangerous_area SET da_status = '4' WHERE idx = #{id}
